startingRoom.name: Entrance Hall
startingRoom.description: You find yourself in a dim room with a stone table to your east. You see an unbreakable door with a strong, golden lock to your west. A long corridor is northward.

items.name: Moldy Cheeseburger
items.description: It's a really, really moldy cheeseburger

corridor.name: Long Corridor
corridor.description: A long, straight corridor. A large room awaits you to the north. The entrance room is to the south.

items.name: Torch
items.description: A stone-shafted torch with a baby flame at the tip

octagon.name: Octagon
octagon.description: A large octagonal-shaped chamber. To the north is a gated pathway. You see doorways both west and east.

control_entrance.name: Control Room Entrance
control_entrance.description: The entrance to an unkempt office area, full of useless papers and empty chairs. There is a hallway to the west, a room entrance to the north, and a large room to the east.

control_hallway.name: Control Room Hallway
control_hallway.description: A hallway connected to mulitple offices. To your south is an office with an unlocked door. There is a doorway to the west. Eastwards leads to the entrance of the control room.

control_room.name: Control Room
control_room.description: A security office with CCTV cameras looking into the prison. You have no idea how to decipher the information on the monitors. The hallway you entered through is east, and there is a door to your north.

electrical_room.name: Electrical Room
electrical_room.description: A disastrous room with broken control panels, uncontrolled distribution boards, and no features to ensure your safety. You can exit the room by going south.

items.name: Wire
items.description: A spare wire on the ground that looks risky to take without getting electrocuted

warden_office.name: Warden's Office
warden_office.description: A well-sized office with a polished brown desk and a leather office chair. Northwards leads to the exit of the office.

items.name: Warden's Key
items.description: A black key with a sleek, fancy design

armory.name: Armory
armory.description: A trashed room with broken weapons scattered across the floor. To your north is a door with a lock made of gilded steel.

items.name: Cool Cheeseburger
items.description: It's a really, really cool cheeseburger

forge.name: The Forge
forge.description: A spacious room with a hard-working gnome called Gerald. He seems to have been trapped here for decades forging weapons. South leads to the armory. You see a locked door to your north. Gerald will not let you in until you have done something for him.

items.name: Keycard
items.description: A Keycard with the name John on it

cool_weapon_room.name: Gerald's Special Place
cool_weapon_room.description: Gerald welcomes you to his special place.

items.name: Giant Gnome
items.description: Its a really oversized gnome with a blade.

prison.name: Prison
prison.description: A large prison with moss growing from the ceiling and the ground. You see hallways to your north and south. There is very large room to the west.

north_hallway.name: North Prison Hallway
north_hallway.description: The northern hallway of an ancient prison. South leads back to the entrance of the prison. The hallway continues to the east.

south_hallway.name: South Prison Hallway
south_hallway.description: The southern hallway of an ancient prison. North leads back to the entrance of the prison. Going east takes you up a flight of stairs.

balcony.name: Balcony
balcony.description: A room exposed to the outdoors with an astonishingly beautiful yet unsettling view of the mountains. The snowy winter wind is calming, but leaves you questioning where you really are, and what your purpose here is. There is a locked door with a slot to put in a card with the name John to the south. Go west to descend down the flight of stairs.

closet.name: Closet
closet.description: A suffocating spider-infested room that you guess has not seen the light in centuries. The only exit is north.

items.name: Wire
items.description: A spare wire on the ground that looks risky to take without getting electrocuted

north_hallway_cell_one.name: North Prison Hallway
north_hallway_cell_one.description: The middle of the northern hallway. West takes you to the beginning of the hallway. East takes you to the end of the hallway. There is an open prison cell to your south.

north_hallway_cell_two.name: North Prison Hallway
north_hallway_cell_two.description: The end of the northern hallway. West takes you to the middle of the hallway. The door to your north has a black lock with a sleek, fancy design. There is an open prison cell to your south with a very kind inmate ushering you in! Oh wait, that's just a skeleton.

cell_one.name: Open Prison Cell
cell_one.description: An unkempt prison cell with a single mattress. North takes you out of the cell. You find a hole in the cell to your east. It seems to lead into another cell.

cell_two.name: Open Prison Cell
cell_two.description: An unkempt prison cell with a single mattress. A skeleton of an inmate seems to have been trying to reach out of the cell before he sadly passed away. North takes you out of the cell. There is a hole in the cell to your west. It seems to lead into another cell.

ruined_room.name: Ruined Room
ruined_room.description: A dark room with a strange dark red liquid leaking from the ceiling. You see moss and molding growing on the walls as your vision begins to blur. There is a fork in the path. You can either go east or west. Going back south where you came from gurantees your safety.

arena.name: The Arena
arena.description: An arena modestly lit by bright orange torches. The walls are made of iron bars, acting as large prison cells to hold unworldly creatures. You hear heavy breathing and growling from the other side of the bars, however you cannot see past the bars due to the darkness. However you notice north of you, that there is a wall that is a little broken. Maybe something really heavy can break it. Like something REALLY heavy. Like tungstein heavy East takes you back to the ruined room.

Secret arena room.name: The Medical Room
Secret arena room.description: It's an abandonned medical room, used for sick people, filled with moss, ruined floor tiles, and empty hospital beds.

items.name: Lifeblood
items.description: A vial with blue liquid in it called Lifeblood

torture_room.name: Torture Room
torture_room.description: A cruel torture room with bodies hanging from the ceiling by hooks. You are unsure how much further you want to explore this area. You can turn back now by going west through the door which you came. However, there is a mysterious gray door to the north that is open slightly.

execution_room.name: Execution Room
execution_room.description: A room with the sole purpose of execution. You can see numerous machines used for killing. There are many skeletons just lingering in the room.

items.name: Gilded Steel Key
items.description: A key stuck in the eye of one of the skeleton, made of gilded steel

monsters.name: Serpent
monsters.description: A giant pale serpent blocks your path.

inventory.name: The Pale Pendant
inventory.description: A pale pendant. Pick this up and you are marked forever.

The Pale Seal.name: Pale Forest
The Pale Seal.description: You stand in a beautiful pale, snowy forest. You can hear the birds chirping and the wind rustling. Congrats. You got out of the cellar.
